requirement.description: {requirements_reuben} asked for a full review of the hand-over from the model registry to the CI/CD pipeline. A formal sign-off at the registry hand-over ensures the consent flag is verified before the build.
requirement.fact: {requirements_reuben} asked for a full review of the hand-over from the model registry to the CI/CD pipeline.
requirement.reading: A formal sign-off at the registry hand-over ensures the consent flag is verified before the build.

speaker.name: Requirements Reuben
speaker.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

output.objection: You cannot just assume the consent flag is there because the model ran last week. I need a formal sign-off at the registry hand-over so we verify that personal data compliance before the build even starts.
output.correction: I am not asking for a new security tool, I am asking for a strict review of the hand-over process itself. The gap is the missing verification step between the model registry and the pipeline, not the code inside the model.
